versions.subject: bulk of new rules to match working UACMe UAC bypasses
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\changepk.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\slui.exe'
    IntegrityLevel: 'High'
condition: selection

versions.subject: add System IntegrityLevel to uac bypass rules, the level is not used most of the time, but might
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\changepk.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\slui.exe'
    IntegrityLevel:
      - 'High'
      - 'System'
condition: selection
